chapter: Cafe Society and the Zodiac Suite
title: Lost recordings and the Rome performance of the suite
summary: Recordings of the Carnegie concert and the Town Hall concert were stolen. She later did the suite in Rome with an 18-piece group.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Was there any interest in recording it then?
Yes, but somebody stole it. Someone stole that recording and somebody stole the recording of the concert that Barney did for me at Town Hall.
Barney's concert at Town Hall was a separate thing, is that right?
I did the 'Zodiac Suite' in Rome with a combo of about 18 men including oboe, flute, and all that, violins.
So that meant all new arrangements for that too?
Oh, yes. Milton helped me. I gave him the ideas and he wrote some down and he helped me when I'd get stuck.
